chunks: And everything in it narrated from Abd Al-Ala, the freed servant of Al-Sam, has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah be pleased with him - from Al-Hasan ibn Mithl, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khattab, from Jafar ibn Bashir, from Khalid ibn Abi Ismail, from Abd Al-Ala, the freed servant of Al-Sam.

key_terms.مولى آل سام: Mawla Al-Sam (freed servant of the family of Sam)

ai.seo_question: How is the transmission chain for Abd Al-Ala verified in Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage serves as a clarifying note (takhrij) regarding the transmission chain (isnad) for narrations attributed to Abd Al-Ala in the book. The author confirms that all reports from this specific narrator were transmitted through a verified chain starting with himself, passing through several prominent scholars, and ending with Abd Al-Ala. It highlights the meticulous attention to chain integrity in Shia hadith scholarship, ensuring the reliability of Abd Al-Ala's reports by tracing them back to a single, authoritative source.
